beschreibung: Drachenspiel Tische in 4K (nur Querformat/Desktop): dieselben sechs Motive wie drachenspiel-tische.json, neu in 4K erzeugt mit dem bisherigen Tisch als Referenz, damit sie am Desktop scharf bleiben. Ersetzt tisch-<haus>-quer.webp.
stil: Painterly storybook oil illustration of a game table seen from steeply above, a camera angle of about 70 to 75 degrees, almost a bird's-eye view, like the playful board in Hearthstone. A slight wide-angle fisheye effect: the rim and the table edges bulge gently outward, the picture feels round, cheerful and toy-like, with chunky, charmingly exaggerated decoration. A wide, heavy table surface fills the picture from edge to edge. In the calm centre lies an empty, evenly lit playing mat; it stays plain, darker and uncluttered so that cards and interface elements can be laid over it. One thin horizontal centre line runs from the left rim to the right rim across the middle of the mat (never a vertical line). The mat is wide: its far edge is at least 92 percent as wide as its near edge (almost a rectangle, hardly any trapezoid), and only a slim wooden rim frames it at the sides. Rich detailed decoration only at the far edge and in the outer corners; the near edge at the bottom is a plain dark table rim. Warm, soft light, rich colours; depth is only hinted, details shrink just slightly towards the far edge. No people, no animals, no characters, no faces, no cards, no game pieces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame.
